description: Works to trees in Bush Hill Park Conservation area: 1x Cherry (T1) - crown reduction by up to 2m in branch length on all aspects, crown thin by 15%, crown lift to 2.5m above ground level over the play area, 1x Fig (T2) - crown reduce by up to 0.5m back to previous pruning points on all sides, 1x Hornbeam (T3) - lateral prune on garden side back to the boundary line, reducing encroaching branches by up to 1.5m, 1x Hazel (T4) - height reduction by 2.4m to previous reduction points, proportional lateral reduction by up to 1m.
